label: champ_0080_dragon_02
text: You appear to be progressing well on your\nGym circuit.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0080_ground_01
text: What’s this now? Is this that kid I’ve been hearing\nso much about?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0080_ground_02
text: Hey, kiddo! I heard you’re, like, way too good\nat battling! Yeah?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0080_select_01
text: Yeah!

label: champ_0080_select_02
text: Not THAT good...

label: champ_0080_ground_03a
text: Nahaha! You got some spirit, big shot![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0080_ground_03b
text: Pah! You can’t fool me that easily. No need to\nplay humble, you hear?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0080_dragon_03
text: This young lady would be Rika.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0080_ground_04
text: That’s me! Rika here, at your service.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_ground_05
text: And hey, I know I’m pretty, but no need to get\nintimidated or anything.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_dragon_04
text: She is a little...farcical, shall we say. But like\nmyself, she is a member of the Elite Four.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0080_ground_06
text: What? I wasn’t tryin’ to be funny...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_ground_07
text: Aaanyway... Hmm.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_ground_08
text: Tell you something, kiddo—you look fun.\nLike, interesting. At a glance, anyway.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_dragon_05
text: Naturally. [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe is one of our academy’s esteemed\nstudents.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0080_ground_09
text: Oooh, haha. Yeah, that checks out.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_ground_10
text: But the battles you’ll face at these Gyms really\nratchet up the farther you go.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_dragon_06
text: Indeed. Your average Trainer abandons the\nchallenge at roughly this very point.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0080_ground_11
text: But not you, right, kiddo?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_ground_12
text: See you when you hit the Champion Assessment.\nYou show these Gyms what you’ve got![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0080_dragon_07
text: Best of fortunes to you.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
